location_description: A vast nocturnal Victorian poison greenhouse with black wrought-iron ribs, fogged glass panes, a huge moon beyond the roof, tangled sentient vines, toxic bell flowers, blue aconites and a round veined marble pedestal at its center

characters.name: Belladone
characters.emotion: waiting gleefully for an unconvincing denial
characters.position: left foreground watching Aconit instead of the chest
characters.visual_description: Predominantly botanical flower-woman with a lightly humanized lavender face emerging from a broad deep-plum belladonna corolla, large expressive violet eyes, petal curls instead of human hair, leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture
characters.wardrobe: Her silhouette is formed entirely by layered plum petals, dark olive sepals and flexible climbing vines, with no ordinary fabric clothing, shoes or human accessories
signature_details: tiny black heart marking under the right eye
cluster of exactly three glossy black belladonna berries at the left hip
purple heart-shaped nectar gem at the throat

characters.name: Aconit
characters.emotion: deadpan denial with barely contained embarrassment
characters.position: right foreground with folded leaf arms
characters.visual_description: Predominantly botanical monkshood flower-woman with a lightly humanized cool-blue face nested inside a tall cobalt aconite hood, narrow expressive indigo eyes, petal planes instead of human hair, sharp leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture
characters.wardrobe: Her severe silhouette is formed entirely by overlapping indigo petals, a pointed blue monkshood hood and a dark silver-green leaf collar, with no ordinary fabric clothing, shoes or human accessories
signature_details: single silver crescent marking beneath the left eye
two small blue aconite blossoms growing from the right shoulder vine

characters.name: La Graine Noire
characters.position: center background revealed as the chest opens
characters.visual_description: A glossy black botanical seed shaped like a small anatomical heart, split by one thin violet seam, with tiny rootlets like veins and no human face, limbs or readable species
characters.wardrobe: Its only covering is a wet obsidian shell with a subtle violet inner glow and delicate vein-like roots that move with deliberate intelligence

camera.movement: hold on Aconit's reply then rack focus to the opening chest

action: Aconit folds her leaves and replies without blinking while the two small flowers on her shoulder nod against her; behind them the chest clicks open and reveals the pulsing black seed
lighting: cool blue on Aconit interrupted by a rising violet underlight from the chest
mood: deadpan comedy tipping into supernatural menace

render.negative_prompt: cute seed face, photorealistic humans, human hair, fabric dresses, gore, blood, text, subtitles, logo, watermark
